instruction: Install DAViCal CalDAV server on Debian 12
output: sudo apt install davical && sudo a2enmod rewrite && sudo systemctl restart apache2

instruction: Set DAV depth to 0 in Apache config
output: echo 'DAVDepth 0' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/dav-depth.conf && sudo a2enconf dav-depth && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Set minimum DAV properties in Apache
output: echo 'DAVMinPropTimeOut 60' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/conf-available/dav-minprop.conf && sudo a2enconf dav-minprop && sudo systemctl reload apache2
